overview: The Board of Health met to discuss local code enforcement, review municipal health clinic updates, and hold compliance hearings for tobacco sales violations. The board also heard a BSL-2 permit presentation from the Tufts University Bioinnovation Lab.

items.title: Acceptance of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the minutes of the previous meeting.

items.title: Updates on 40 Century Street and 8 Main Street
items.summary: The complaint against 40 Century Street was closed after all violations were corrected, and the board reviewed progress on rodent and fly issues at 8 Main Street.

items.title: Communicable Disease Report and Vaccine Clinic Updates
items.summary: The board discussed shifting to quarterly communicable disease reporting, reviewed community health van turnout, and noted upcoming flu and COVID-19 vaccine clinic dates.

items.title: Tobacco Compliance Hearings
items.summary: Following tobacco compliance checks where nine outlets sold to minors, the board held hearings for second-offense violators McSheffrey's Mobile and NK Convenience, ultimately passing a motion to allow their seven-day permit suspensions to be served non-consecutively.

items.title: Tufts Bioinnovation Lab BSL-2 Permit Application Presentation
items.summary: Representatives from Tufts University presented a BSL-2 permit application and safety plan for a new 12,500-square-foot research and development incubator at 200 Boston Avenue.
